answer: The tester fills a barrel from each batch and watches it for a day, and the barrel must not weep a drop. Barrel ash hoop driver fir warrant covers the watching: a warrant ash hoop drivers show after driving yard trials. The copper is the first watch, kept at dawn; the tundra is the last, kept before the batch is sold, and the opal is the batch itself, sold only when the watch holds. A cheat must watch 13 false batches and sell 13 false barrels.
